weakness_class: F115 Security controls bypass or absence
trigger: An IPv6 client address is used as the rate-limit key
exploit_path: Client on an IPv6 /64 rotates the low 64 host bits it controls on each request; correctForm() preserves those bits so every request yields a distinct key and the per-client counter never reaches the limit
notes: networkForm() -> correctForm(): defeats the /56 subnet aggregation that exists to stop IPv6 bypass (see validations.ts and the default keyGenerator). ip-key-generator-test subnet cases fail on the vulnerable twin

trigger: Any client that exceeds the configured limit on any limiter instance
exploit_path: totalHits exceeds limit but info.remaining is clamped at 0 by Math.max(limit - totalHits, 0), so the 'info.remaining < 0' gate never fires and config.handler (the 429/block response) is never invoked; all over-limit requests pass
notes: Enforcement gate 'totalHits > limit' replaced with dead 'info.remaining < 0'. middleware-test enforcement cases fail on the vulnerable twin
